sources.note: The reported farewell wording is وخواتيم عملك. This proposal adopts that wording without making any claim that other transmitted variants are invalid.
The app's existing cited report also has وخواتيم عملك, not آخر عملك.

travel_astawdiuka.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
travel_astawdiuka.transliteration: Astawdi'ullaha dinaka wa amanataka wa khawatima 'amalik
travel_astawdiuka.translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the final deeds of your life.
Aku titipkan kepada Allah agamamu, amanahmu, dan amal-amal penutup hidupmu.
